children: Overview
China off-price retailer's Q3 revenue fell 5% yr/yr to RMB20.4 bln
Adjusted net income for Q3 declined yr/yr
Company announced US$338 mln special dividend and expanded share repurchase program
Outlook
Vipshop expects Q4 2026 net revenues between RMB29.2 bln and RMB30.9 bln
Company forecasts Q4 2026 revenue to decline 10% to 5% year over year
Vipshop says Q4 outlook reflects current market and operational conditions
Result Drivers
CHALLENGING DEMAND - Co said it faced a complex retail environment and a challenging demand landscape in Q3
CORE CUSTOMER FOCUS - Co said refining merchandising strategy and focusing on high-value core supply helped sustain retention and growth among Super VIP customers
SHAN SHAN OUTLETS GROWTH - Shan Shan Outlets segment revenue and operating income increased yr/yr, though this segment is a small part of overall business
